name: Darkness in the Glade

angles.text: Fel corruption in sacred boughs like the Oracle Glade threatens the kaldorei effort to nurture and protect Teldrassil.
Sentinel Cloudsbreak serves Darnassus through its vigilance against demonic corruption threatening Alliance lands.
Fel moss among wildlife and leather fibers points to an unnatural blight upsetting the World Tree's natural balance.

aliases: what is darkness in the glade
faq.answer: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak investigates strange taint in harpy belts in the Oracle Glade. She sends you to recover amulets from the harpy leaders and learn what is behind the affliction.
faq.q: What is Darkness in the Glade?

aliases: who gives darkness in the glade
faq.answer: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak asks for your help. She watches over Teldrassil's boughs from the Oracle Glade and investigates strange changes among its harpies.
Arynia found tainted fibers in belts taken from common harpies and needs more proof. She suspects the leaders' amulets may reveal the blight's nature and origin.
faq.q: Why does Arynia want amulets from the harpy leaders?

faq.answer: The amulets belong to three leaders in western nests: Hatescreech, Windmistress Gaedress, and Witchmother Arysa.
faq.q: Which harpy leaders hold the amulets?

faq.answer: Fel moss is causing the corruption. Arynia finds foul green swirls in the recovered amulets' gemstones, proof that fel moss is tainting the region.
faq.q: What is causing the corruption in the glade?

faq.answer: Yes. Arynia has heard reports of fel moss turning the land against the night elves in Shadowglen and other boughs across the world tree.
faq.q: Has this corruption appeared anywhere else?

sections.body: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak finds something wrong among the harpies of the Oracle Glade. Their leather belts carry an unnatural taint woven through the fibers. She suspects demonic corruption, not ordinary aggression. Before she warns Darnassus, she needs proof.
sections.title: Tainted Fibers

sections.body: Arynia sends you to the western nests to face three harpy matriarchs: Hatescreech, Windmistress Gaedress, and Witchmother Arysa. Each carries an amulet marked by her power. The gems hold foul green swirls. They confirm fel moss is warping the harpies and seeping into Teldrassil's sacred boughs.
sections.title: A Blight Confirmed

summary: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak investigates tainted harpy belts in the Oracle Glade. Their amulets may show what is spreading through Teldrassil.
attribution: In-game quest text: Darkness in the Glade
